{{Quote|Without the mask he looked more human. It was easier to remember he was just a man, with all the weaknesses and vulnerabilities that implied. With the mask, however, Revan was an icon, a symbol. He was the shaper of history, an individual defined by his actions rather than his thoughts, feelings, and beliefs.|Meetra Surik, reflecting on what Revan's mask represented|<ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref>}}
During the early skirmishes of the [[Mandalorian Wars]], this '''mask''' belonged to a [[Unidentified Mandalorian female|Mandalorian female]]. In [[3973 BBY]], the mask remained on the shores of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cathar (location)/Legends|Cathar]] after the woman's [[Death/Legends|death]] during the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]]' [[Battle of Cathar|attack]] on the world. [[3963 BBY|Ten years later]], the mask was pivotal in the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan's]] efforts to find evidence of the [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Species/Legends|species]]' [[Speciecide|genocide]]; Revan claimed the [[Gender/Legends|woman's]] mask as his own, vowing not to remove it until the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] were defeated permanently. [[3960 BBY|One year]] after Revan and his [[Revanchist|faction of Jedi]] [[Battle of Malachor V|successfully defended]] the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and vanquished the Mandalorians, Revan declared himself the new [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and ignited the [[Jedi Civil War]]. [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Revan wore the mask up until his [[Capture of Darth Revan|capture]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].

==Usage==
{{Quote|So you wouldn't recognize Revan if the two of you met?"''<br />"''Is there any reason I should? Beside the fact that I did not know Revan in life, Revan was known for wearing a full helmet and cape.|Revan and [[Yuthura Ban]], about the former's old identity as the Dark Lord|<ref name="KotOR game" />}}
This mask was originally worn as a part of a [[Unidentified Mandalorian female|Mandalorian female's]] [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|armor]], and had a [[red]] and [[gray]] color. [[3963 BBY|Ten years]] after her [[Death/Legends|death]]<ref name="KotOR 42" /> during the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]]' [[Speciecide|genocide]] of the [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Species/Legends|people]] on their [[Cathar (location)/Legends|homeworld]] in [[3973 BBY]],<ref name="KotOR CG" /> the mask was claimed by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and was immediately donned by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="KotOR 42" /> Revan continued to wear the mask as he led the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to [[Battle of Malachor V|victory]] against the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]].<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref> After becoming a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] under the [[Sith training|tutelage]] of a [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]]<ref name="T8: TJCW">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 8: The Jedi Civil War|int=Timeline 8: The Jedi Civil War}}</ref> and eventually declaring himself the new [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Revan wore the mask as part of his [[Darth Revan's robes|personal armor]],<ref name="KotOR game" /> up until his [[Capture of Darth Revan|capture]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and Republic forces in [[3957 BBY]].<ref name="KotOR CG" /> Revan wore the mask once more on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] when he [[Attack on the Sith Emperor|confronted]] the Sith Emperor.<ref name="Revan" />

==History==
{{Quote|They were beaten! You didn't have to do it! One of you knew, but you didn't listen! I don't know your name&mdash;but I take up your cause. I will not remove your mask until there is justice&mdash;until the Mandalorians have been defeated once and for all. So swears&hellip;''Revan''!|Revan, after the vision of the Mandalorians slaughtering the Cathar|<ref name="KotOR 42" />}}
[[File:RevanFindsAPrettyGirlMask-KotOR42.jpg|thumb|left|Revan discovering the mask on Cathar.]]
During the early battles of the [[Mandalorian Wars]], this mask was worn by a [[Unidentified Mandalorian female|Mandalorian female]] who was present during the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]]' [[Battle of Cathar|devastation]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] Cathar. After driving the [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Species/Legends|people]] into the [[Ocean/Legends|sea]], the woman tried to convince [[Cassus Fett]]&mdash;who led the attack against the planet&mdash;not to kill the Cathar, believing that they had been sufficiently defeated. However, Fett refused and ordered his Mandalorians to exterminate the Cathar; the woman died trying to defend the Cathar as they were slaughtered, and her mask washed up on the shores of the planet.<ref name="KotOR 42" />

[[File:RevanIsBorn-KotOR42.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Revan dons the Mandalorian mask and vows to defeat the Mandalorians.]]
Ten years later, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], his friend and fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight [[Darth Malak|Malak]], and their [[Revanchist|faction of Jedi]] were on Cathar searching for evidence of the Mandalorians' slaughter of the Cathar people. [[Vrook Lamar]], a member of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], and a team of Council loyalists arrived on planet and confronted the [[Revanchist]]s, ordering them to abandon their efforts. During the discussion, Revan noticed the mask which had belonged to the Mandalorian woman and picked it up. When light shone on the mask, all of the Jedi present experienced a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] of the battle that had taken place a decade prior. After the vision's completion, Revan recognized that the Mandalorian female tried to defend the Cathar and perished as a result of the Mandalorians' desire to massacre defenseless civilians. In honor of her sacrifice, Revan donned her mask, vowing not to remove it until he and his followers brought the Mandalorians to justice.<ref name="KotOR 42" />

[[File:Masked_Revan.png|thumb|left|150px|Revan wearing the mask 300 years later during the Cold War]]
Revan continued to wear the mask throughout the conflict, which concluded with the near extermination of the Mandalorians in the war's [[Battle of Malachor V|final battle]] at [[Malachor V]] in [[3960 BBY]].<ref name="KotOR CG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> The two Jedi Knights then fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] under the guidance of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]];<ref name="T8: TJCW" /> although Revan eventually declared himself [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], with Malak becoming his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], and thus establishing their own [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]]. Revan continued to wear the mask during the [[Jedi Civil War]] until Malak betrayed and left his [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] for [[Death/Legends|dead]] in [[3957 BBY]]. When Revan's comatose body was recovered by the [[Jedi strike team (Capture of Darth Revan)|Jedi strike team]] sent to [[Capture of Darth Revan|capture]] him, the Jedi Council repaired the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord's]] damaged mind and saved his life, but also reprogrammed him with an artificial persona, one who was loyal to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="DB-Malak, Darth">{{DB|character|darthmalak|Malak, Darth}}</ref><ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|II|279|Malak, Darth}}</ref>

Unbeknownst to even the Jedi Council, [[Bastila Shan]], the leader of the Jedi strike team that captured [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Revan, recovered the mask and hid it for many years. She feared that the mask would not only cause Revan to regain all of his lost memories, but would also restore his original persona, as well as the dark side within him. After Revan disappeared, the Jedi [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|Exile]] [[Meetra Surik]] set out to find him. Before she left, Shan gave the mask to her with instructions to give it to Revan. Surik eventually found Revan on the Sith world [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. After the mask was given to Revan by Surik, all of his memories came back to him.<ref name="Revan" />

[[File:Revan_remains.png|thumb|right|Revan's mask, scarred from the battle on the Foundry, left behind on Yavin 4 after his permanent physical death]]
After Revan's defeat at the hands of the Sith Emperor, the mask remained the property of the Sith for centuries. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] era, it was in possession of the rogue Sith Lord [[Grathan]] until it was stolen by the [[Order of Revan|Revanites]], a Sith cult dedicated to emulating the life and teachings of Darth Revan. After Revan was freed from his prison he reacquired the mask and wore it once more, until he was confronted by a Sith strike team at [[Foundry (space station)|The Foundry]].<ref name="The Foundry">{{TORcite|type=Flashpoint|The Foundry}}</ref> The mask was damaged during his defeat, with a deep vertical scratch scarring the left part of the mask and crossing the eye slit.<ref name="Legacy of the Rakata">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=tactical|Legacy of the Rakata}}</ref> His body controlled by the dark half of his spirit, Revan wore the mask with his tattered robes until being confronted by Republic and Imperial champions on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. After he was defeated and the two halves of his spirit were reunited, Revan's physical body faded away, leaving his mask, lightsaber, and tattered robes behind.<ref name="The Enemy Within">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=general|The Enemy Within|Yavin 4}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Revan's mask first appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', developed by [[BioWare]].<ref name="KotOR game" /> The backstory of how Revan acquired the mask was explained in the standalone [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] [[Knights of the Old Republic 42|''Masks'']], which was the forty-second issue of the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'' comic series]], written by [[John Jackson Miller]].<ref name="KotOR 42" /> The mask was featured in a preview for BioWare's upcoming PC game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' that was released on the game's [http://swtor.com official website]. In the video, the player-controlled character fights to shut down an ancient complex that was constructed by Darth Revan during his tenure as a Sith Lord. Near the end of the video, the scene cuts to what appears to be a tomb and Revan's mask lying in front of it.<ref name="TORweb-Mysteries of Knights of the Old Republic">{{TORweb|url=news/news-article/20100904|text=Mysteries of Knights of the Old Republic|nolive=1}}</ref> While both ''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'' and ''Masks'' portray the helmet as having been colored red and gray, various artwork depicts the mask as having been only red.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''; [[:File:Revan chokes officer.jpg|Image]] of Darth Revan using the Force to choke a Sith officer</ref><ref name="Timeline 8: The Jedi Civil War">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 8: The Jedi Civil War|int=Timeline 8: The Jedi Civil War}}; [[:File:Birth Darth Revan Darth Malak.jpg|Image]] of Darth Revan and Darth Malak on Dromund Kaas</ref>

Revan's mask was featured on [[Hasbro]]'s action figure of Darth Revan in the third quarter of [[2007]].<ref name="Hasbro figure">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: 30th Anniversary Collection|pack=#34: Darth Revan (Sith Lord)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TAC34revan.asp}}</ref> The mask was also featured on Revan's miniature figure in [[The Force Unleashed (Star Wars Miniatures)|''The Force Unleashed'']] set of ''[[Star Wars Miniatures]]'', released on [[November 16]], 2007.<ref>{{WebCite|url=http://www.miniaturetrading.com/im/selectCard/series981|text=The Force Unleashed at Miniature Trading|archivedate=20071121103731}}</ref> In [[2009]], the mask was a part of Mighty Muggs' figure of Darth Revan.<ref>{{WebCite|url=http://www.kid4life.com/yoda2/DarthRevanMM.htm|text=Darth Revan Mighty Muggs Review at Yodasnews.com|author=Jeffrey A. Gouse|date=2009-01-13|archivedate=20171011222246}}</ref> A minature bust of Darth Revan, which features the mask, was released in [[January]] [[2011]] by [[Gentle Giant Studios]].<ref>{{SW|subdomain=shop|url=catalog/product.xml?topcatID=1300264;product_id=1318426|text=Darth Revan mini bust}}</ref>
